_provenance: rows copied from signed UNMASKED_ANALYSIS records; the L4 re-reading is read-only and does not touch the frozen artifact

l4_defect.failure_mode: when the members that reach a level swap places across configurations, the level sets match and L4 emits, asserting replication for a result that is configuration-dependent.
l4_defect.registered_rule: §3.2 licenses L1 on 'the named D(c <- g)', and §28.1 pairs Replication ('the same classification in every registered configuration') with Configuration dependence ('the quantity is configuration-dependent; the table is reported and no pooled scalar is quoted'). Both rows are about a NAMED quantity, so the gate is per member.
l4_defect.scope: L4 only. It reads emitted statements; it does not enter any estimate, interval, bootstrap draw, precision check, F6 gate, or L1/L2/L3 licensing decision.
l4_defect.what_it_does: analysis.claims.emit_l4 compares the SET of claim levels reached in each configuration. run/analysis_run.py builds that input as [s['claim_level'] for s in statements if emitted], discarding the member identity before the emitter sees it.
l4_defect.why_not_repaired: run_unmasked_analysis refuses an unmasked analysis under an analysis_code_hash differing from the masked seal, and §20 forbids regenerating a mask after semantic identities are known.
